worker_crash.answer: A provider runtime dying between turns can look idle until reported; Claude and OMP report such exits as turn failures; OMP relaunches from its session file.

service_restart.answer: Optional agents.resumeOnStartup reopens running agents after graceful shutdown or crash using their saved provider conversation/settings and sends a configurable continuation. Default is off; idle/initializing and Hub executions follow separate lifecycle.

expiry.answer: Resumable idle processes are released after one hour, with provider safety vetoes and host-wide disable setting; next prompt resumes the retained session. This is process cleanup, not deletion of the conversation.

transcript_reload.answer: Timelines persist; Antigravity transcript starts fresh after daemon restart; changelog fixed Claude history after restart in some cases.

process_reconnect.answer: Closed runtimes are replaced by resuming their durable provider conversation under the same Paseo ID; live process attachment across replacement is not promised.

task_resume.answer: Closed agents resume the durable provider session under the same Paseo ID.

state_reconstruction.answer: Reopen retains identity, timeline, workspace, labels, usage, attention and parentage; explicit creation environment overrides are reapplied. This does not restore arbitrary detached process state.

context_loss.answer: Provider resume owns conversation restoration. A provider crash can lose background shells/watches; queued in-memory prompts can be lost, and best-effort startup continuation may be lost or repeated.

duplicate_actions.answer: Hub dispatch uses a stable execution ID so the daemon returns the existing agent instead of rerunning.

manual_repair.answer: Failed reopen is logged with no recovery retry loop. Once old runtime closure succeeds a failed resume remains closed and retryable; ambiguous close failures block replacement.

service_restart.answer: Optional agents.resumeOnStartup reopens running agents after graceful shutdown or crash using their saved provider conversation/settings and sends a configurable continuation. Default is off; idle/initializing and Hub executions follow separate lifecycle.

expiry.answer: Resumable idle processes are released after one hour, with provider safety vetoes and host-wide disable setting; next prompt resumes the retained session. This is process cleanup, not deletion of the conversation.

process_reconnect.answer: Closed runtimes are replaced by resuming their durable provider conversation under the same Paseo ID; live process attachment across replacement is not promised.

state_reconstruction.answer: Reopen retains identity, timeline, workspace, labels, usage, attention and parentage; explicit creation environment overrides are reapplied. This does not restore arbitrary detached process state.
